thread:
sasha: FYI — customer FinOps requested we push cost-per-route + trace-linking into next observability launch. They want per-model token cost + trace IDs on error events. Any quick take?

jamal: We can expose per-model cost in dashboards via sampled telemetry + aggregation, but it won't be realtime. sampling rate will drive accuracy :thinking_face:

maria: Do they have an SLA for the numbers? Also need to know which routes: inference vs embeddings vs admin.

kevin: Tracing hooks are about 50% done. Missing trace-id propagation from edge -> runtime. I can spike a patch but need ~2d.

sasha: Proposal: ship a 'Cost Explorer' 24h/7d/30d with per-model aggregation and an opt-in trace header that surfaces trace_id in error events. That would unblock the ask without full realtime billing changes. Thoughts?

jamal: Sounds reasonable. If we do sampling we should default to 10% for production, can increase for enterprise.

maria: We'll also need billing pipeline changes: add billing tags (model_name, route_name, quant_profile). That requires a small schema bump.

kevin: Quick patch idea for trace propagation (middleware):
```python
# minimal middleware for trace id propagation
def inject_trace(req):
    tid = req.headers.get("x-rw-trace-id") or generate_id()
    req.ctx['trace_id'] = tid
    req.headers['x-rw-trace-id'] = tid
    return req
```

kevin: That gets us trace ids in logs and error payloads with minimal runtime change. We still need to wire it through the KV cache and batching layer.

maria: Good. Also update cost pipeline: ensure tag joins happen before daily aggregation. Ops needs to estimate ingestion cost. @ops-bot can you run a rough cost estimate for 1M tokens/day with 10% telemetry sampling?

ops-bot: ops-bot: cost-estimate job queued: job id 98321, ETA ~12m :hourglass_flowing_sand:

jamal: If 10% sampling is acceptable to customer, the Cost Explorer will answer 90% of their questions and avoids per-request billing semantics.

sasha: Draft launch criteria (proposed):
- Cost Explorer dashboard (24h/7d/30d) with per-model & per-route aggregation
- Opt-in trace header (x-rw-trace-id) propagated end-to-end + one integration test
- Billing tags captured for top 5 customer routes and surfaced in analytics

sasha: Fallback/rollback: if any item is delayed, mark feature as 'beta' behind account flag and communicate to FinOps customers.

maria: :thumbsup: Can we get PM signoff? @emily

emily: emily: I support the criteria. Request canary rollout to 2 enterprise customers first. Need acceptance checklist for their legal/data teams.

jamal: I'll schedule the 2-day spike for trace propagation and draft the acceptance checklist.

kevin: I'll start the runtime patch and add tests for header propagation.

sasha: Thanks team — I'll consolidate this into a short decision doc and post to the roadmap board.

maria: Quick note: we'll need to update the SDK docs for the header example and add a migration note for billing.

ops-bot: ops-bot: cost-estimate job 98321 complete: estimated additional telemetry cost ~$180/month @ 10% sampling for 1M tokens/day.

jamal: That cost looks reasonable for pilot. Scheduling follow-ups with FinOps next week. :calendar:

sasha: Closing the loop — action owners: jamal (spike + checklist), kevin (runtime patch), maria (billing pipeline), emily (enterprise canary).
